shortDescription: A machine learning model built by Bloomberg Economics expects the Bank of England to raise interest rates in February, earlier than most forecasters, according to Bloomberg.The model uses past policy decisions to predict future moves.

title: AI Model Built by Bloomberg Sees Bank of England Rate Hike in February
